evidence.snippet: - The coordinator may do two things in the maintainer's place, and nothing else, and neither on a pull request it wrote: dismiss an equivalent mutant, and dismiss a refuted injection flag on a line of Melian's own prompt text that the change only moved. Every policy notice is the maintainer's to read, the override status of the outage procedure is his to post, and a finding that restates a ruling is his to dismiss. For each, the coordinator sends him one message that quotes the change or the finding, and records his answer on the pull request. [The decision](docs/decisions/2026-11-28-what-the-coordinator-may-do-for-the-maintainer.md) says why.
- Prefer short words and short sentences. If a sentence runs past about 25 words, find the seam.
